articles.title: Bitcoin options remain expensive despite summer calm. Here's why it matters
articles.snippet: Bitcoin’s implied volatility is near a seasonal floor, but options continue to price substantially more movement than the market is delivering.

articles.title: US Treasury moves forward with rules on GENIUS Act after July deadline
articles.snippet: The stablecoin bill signed into law last year is scheduled to go into effect in January 2027, potentially without finalized regulations from US government agencies.

articles.title: Kalshi ordered to stop broad range of prediction markets in Washington
articles.snippet: Kalshi must implement initial geofencing by Aug. 19 and a GeoComply multi-source geofencing system by Sept. 2.
